roundLabel: user-testing - browser automation (agent-browser) with cookie-consent bypass
executiveSummary: 28 of 110 VAL-W1-* assertions tested via browser automation. All assertions requiring committed-workspace canvas access are blocked by a cookie-consent modal overlay (z-index 280) that intercepts pointer events. Assertions testable at overview/landing level pass. Backend returns 500 on mutations. Auth is NOT required (Clerk vars commented out).
